answer.rationale: Current data shows dual decline: activation down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4% QoQ. Memory_91 (activation messaging) and memory_86 (onboarding shortening) are the most directly relevant to both metrics. Activation_messaging is the immediate lever: memory_91 demonstrated it improves week-one engagement and drives first meaningful action. We're verifying memory_86 and memory_91 to confirm their effect sizes and applicability to current cohorts, since activation decline suggests our existing messaging may have degraded or become stale. While memory_31 showed signup simplification worked, we've likely already captured that gain. Promotional_pricing addresses competitor pressure but risks commoditization and margin; referral_incentive requires healthy existing activation to work (which we don't have). Enterprise_sales_assist is orthogonal to our SMB activation crisis. Activation messaging can be deployed quickly, targets the highest-leverage moment in the funnel, and compounds with improved onboarding. A standard_experiment scope lets us measure directional lift on week-one engagement without overcommitting resources. This preserves optionality for follow-up onboarding work if needed.
